name: duopore-public-routine-time-tradeoff
description: Compare two routine plans to see how each uses your weekly time.

interface.longDescription: Compare two routine plans to see how each uses your weekly time. Enter how often and how long you want each activity, your time budget and your own priority weights. See time changes and the scores from your choices. For adults planning their own routines. The app does not pick a best life plan or predict health outcomes.
defaultPrompt: Compare the time needed for these two weekly routines.
What changes if I adjust how often I do these activities?

positive.prompt: Use Routine Time Tradeoff with these explicitly supplied fictional inputs. Return the worksheet and limitations for my review: {"weeklyBudgetMinutes":180,"routines":[{"routine":"Read","minutesEach":30,"priorityPoints":2,"currentFrequency":5,"alternativeFrequency":3},{"routine":"Practice questions","minutesEach":20,"priorityPoints":3,"currentFrequency":2,"alternativeFrequency":4}]}
